status: Implemented and verified locally; owner API/dependency/native-image review and Windows execution remain open before merge.

approval.classification: Backend system extension; production-only File UI with narrow owner approval; existing workspace/context owners reused.
approval.reference_policy: No archived prototype File/Open/Save/recovery behavior was found. This is not claimed as a prototype port. Existing accepted host controls/style are reused; no prototype baseline was changed.
approved_behavior: Nemo title opens Open/Save/Save As/Recover menu; no New action
Restore Session or Keep Current workspace; Keep is the default
Recovery is an untitled copy; original protection persists for the recovered session, including after saving elsewhere

environment.platform: Linux x86_64, native Wayland on COSMIC
environment.native_input: OS evdev/uinput pointer and keyboard; temporary devices released after the run.
environment.capture_limitation: Harness computer.screenshot failed: Wayland capture requires the wayland-pipewire feature. Native capture/input fallback was used only after that failure. No permission changes or installations were made.
environment.viewports: Approximately 1280x720 and 980x640 application windows. Retained crops exclude compositor borders and all unrelated desktop content.
environment.isolation: Temporary project, configuration, data and viewer-cache directories; no user project files were used.

gates.command: cmake --build --preset asan --target nemo_core_tests nemo_workspace_ui_tests nemo_viewer_tests -j 1; cmake --build --preset asan --target nemo_workspace_ui_tests -j 1; ctest --preset asan -R 'PersistenceTest|SessionPersistenceTest|ProjectSessionTest|Interactive\.|PanelContextUiTest' -j 2
gates.scope: Relevant ASan+UBSan ownership, persistence, scheduler/interaction and UI regressions; not the entire sanitizer suite.
Qt-free core build and tests; not a GPU gate.

build_diagnostics: Existing dependency libminizip-ng linker warning about mktemp; no new project-code warning observed.
qmlimportscanner reports missing QtQml qmldir on this system. Builds succeed; no warning-free claim.

headless_roundtrip.output_contract: Full-quality CPU evaluation, byte-identical PPM output (zero tolerance). The render command is a fixed test-pattern smoke and was not used as graph-output evidence.
headless_roundtrip.stable_identity: Network/node/output IDs, animation channel 7 and keys 11/12 survive save/reopen. Broader networks/instances/interfaces/library/bins/marks/opaque-data cases are covered by the persistence suites.
file_state_scenarios: Save establishes a baseline without an undo entry
Edit dirty; undo to saved content clean; redo dirty
Four autosaves retain three slots and do not clear dirty state
Successful open clears old session undo history
Save As rebases an offline source to ../original/media/plate.exr without copying media
headless_roundtrip.source_scope: The retained animation fixture uses real authored constant-color graph evaluation and an unused missing source reference; it is not footage-decode or editorial-workflow evidence.

real_interruption.method: Finite project-session process saving an isolated 16 MiB authored payload; SIGKILL after its exclusive sibling temporary file appeared.
real_interruption.observed: Original bytes unchanged; validate succeeds; a later save succeeds despite the abandoned temp and produces a backup.

failure_and_recovery.real_write_failure: Saving beneath an ordinary file used as a parent fails; last valid project and live session path remain unchanged.
failure_and_recovery.newer_file: Schema 999 rejects open and destructive replacement; final CLI reports unsupported_target.
failure_and_recovery.recovery: Autosave opens untitled/dirty. Save As to original rejects before and after saving a new copy; final CLI reports protected_target. Native chooser overwrite confirmation cannot bypass the backend guard.

malformed_color_config.before_fix: Actual project-session save accepted an object colorConfig and dropped the authored field.
malformed_color_config.after_fix: Actual project-session startup rejects with exit 1 naming colorConfig; bytes remain identical. Regression also proves existing target and previous-good backup survive attempted replacement.

additional_regressions: Exclusive restrictive temporary files; retain existing permissions
Atomic synced backup replacement does not follow a backup symlink
Corrupt owned autosave slot is recycled in place without losing another valid slot
Newer-schema/unknown-required autosaves are protected, and no-safe-slot fails visibly
Save completion from a different project generation is rejected
Document/presentation edits racing a write stay dirty
Unavailable node/animation payload is retained; active uninterpretable animation fails evaluation rather than silently falling back

native_scenarios: Native Save/Save As writes real project files; subsequent Save creates a previous-good .bak. The final chooser-destination safety case is recorded separately.
Open saved project: Keep Current retains the enlarged split; Restore Session returns the saved equal split. Blue viewer output stays unchanged.
Splitter-only presentation change prompts on Quit. Cancel keeps the live edits; original file remains byte-identical.
Natural 120-second dirty timer writes autosave0, then autosave1. Captured graph processing data equals the saved project while presentation differs; original bytes remain unchanged.
Recover actual timed autosave, choose Discard for live edits, receive protected-copy notice, restore presentation.
Attempt to save recovered copy over original through native overwrite confirmation produces actionable refusal; original hash unchanged.
Cancel a pending Save-before-Quit chooser, then save an independent recovered copy: application remains open, proving no stale Quit action.
Edit saved recovery copy and choose Save before Quit: backup is created and application exits 0.
Newer-schema Open displays a concrete schema error and leaves current graph/viewer intact.
Missing external source displays fully wrapped identity/path diagnostics. Its independent graph output remains visible.
Actual window resized narrower; File menu and Save/Discard/Cancel controls remain visible and operable. Discard closes cleanly.

Final native Save As to exact-target-check creates that exact extensionless file and leaves existing exact-target-check.nemo byte-identical; explicit final-native-project.nemo then saves and validates successfully. Application exits cleanly.
native_fixes_proven: Register proper portal filter D-Bus types: Save As no longer crashes.
Call FileChooser.OpenFile, not Open; actual native Open now succeeds.
Publish quiet splitter mutations to persistence dirty tracking without rebuilding the QML tree.
Capture current workspace state, not a stale preset, when saving.
Constrain warning-list width to ScrollView.availableWidth so long paths wrap.
Remove post-dialog suffix rewriting: the application must write the exact chooser-authorized destination, not silently select a different existing .nemo sibling.

project_color_execution.native: Blue viewer renders under the same invalid environment because the project config is passed explicitly. This does not claim measured visible latency or a new image baseline.
